fit_set.method: sha256 (hex) over the UTF-8 bytes of one line per entry of the elements_of_record leaf, each line the entry's key (the arm_id, the leaf's own key), one tab character, then the entry's sha12; the lines sorted bytewise by key and each line followed by one newline character except the last (no trailing newline) — the identity of the SERVED SET, moving with every row added, replaced or re-bound; n_served_elements beside it is the count to check against the table's rows. set_sha256 and n_result_files keep their wave meaning: they count the posterior files in results_dir, not the served set.
fit_set.set_sha256_method: sha256 over sorted(basename + bytes) of the SERVED posterior_summary_*.json files (not_served stems excluded; n_arms counts the same files) — counts the posterior files in results_dir and not the served set, whose identity is served_elements_sha256 (12 Oct 2026)

unfitted_note: models without a posterior fit in the served pool wave or the landed interim models: absent under the Bayesian source, named in the readout

fit_frame.note: served pool fits stand on the wave's own task frame; interim models on the candidate wave's

interim.rule: landed models of the candidate wave drawn as interim; the served pre-§1b rows remain only for models not yet landed; two waves = two fitted axes, disclosed per model

gates.convention: FAIL iff divergences/(chains×samples) > 0.5% or R-hat gate not pass or ESS gate FAIL
gates.line: sampler gate (0.5%-of-draws convention): 32 of 55 pass · max divergence share 0.01% · R-hat ≤ 1.045 · bulk-ESS ≥ 95

basis_truncation.disclosure: basis beyond the measured no-move range (r 0.15; range to 0.129): whether the served crossings moved is measured at this set's re-fit

pool_cells_undercredit.disclosure: the decision of 7 Sep : the composed valid-cells file is the source for a wave 2 cell's attempts and passes (bound through the intake, default flipped 21:37, sha 390f58e212c1; composed cells from the 22:07 pass); the frames these waves were cut from ignored the continuation and redraw legs of arms whose answers were cut at a cap, so those arms' wave 2 cells under-credit passes; waves cut before the 5 Sep collapse of the Claude legs also carried the continuation leg as a second 128-attempt shard of failures

estimand_note: two chains: MEDIAN-TASK (d50/d1, kde ridges, `levels` = exact crossing draws) and AVERAGE-RATE (`levels_avg` = band-inverted from the fit's pointwise average-rate quantile curves; interim estimator)
definition_of_record: reliability = the average-rate 1% crossing (difficulty, Definitions ledger 2026-09-04); the maintainers' exact levels tables = the median-task crossing

1.cause: One draw in ten puts D99 above this band, at harder tasks: on those draws the curve rises past 1% at the band, then dips back under it over the next stretch of tasks before rising past it for good — the middle rule takes that dip's crossing — where the model's failures sit on one task (95 of 96 attempts) and a few beside it (22 tasks, 99 of 3,840 attempts) before 43 tasks it fails on 48 of 1,728.
